messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary probe 'prod-east-canary' failing 3/5 checks (latency spikes). URL: https://monitoring.redwood/logs/…
Priya K: I'm paged, looking. Not seeing broad customer errors yet, only canary failures.
Priya K: Dashboard shows sustained 200->502 on the canary endpoint for the last 3m. No downstream job spikes.
Marco L: Can we confirm if this is probe noise or a real degrad? Any recent deploys to prod-east?
Priya K: No deploys. Investigating probe logs. Attaching snippet.
Priya K: ```
2026-03-15T14:42:01Z GET /health 200 23ms
2026-03-15T14:42:31Z GET /health 502 10ms
2026-03-15T14:43:01Z GET /health 502 9ms
```
Ravi S: Looks like brief flapping. What's our probe interval and failure window?
Janelle F: Current probe config: interval=30s, threshold=3 failures to fire immediate page, window=3m. That can lead to transient pages.
Ravi S: I suspect backend cold-starts in that region + probe concurrency. Recommend increasing interval and require sustained failures.
Marco L: Agreed. Proposal from SRE: change canary alert to only page on 5 failures within 10m, and create a non-paging alert for 3/5 to Slack channel #eng-sre-alerts. Also add a requirement that 3 consecutive failed probes must come from different IPs to avoid single-probe noise.
Priya K: I'm going to mute pager for this alert while we tune; will keep channel notifications on.
Priya K: Commands I'm going to run now:
Priya K: ```bash
# temporarily update synthetic probe config
kubectl -n monitoring set configmap canary-config --from-file=canaries.yaml
# reload monitors
curl -XPOST http://monitoring-api/reload
```
Janelle F: Can we see the canary config we plan to apply? Put it here so we can review.
Priya K: New canary fragment:
Priya K: ```yaml
- name: prod-east-canary
  interval: 60s
  consecutive_failures: 5
  window: 10m
  dedupe_by_ip: true
  paging: false
  alert_channel: "#eng-sre-alerts"
```
Ravi S: Also add a short-term suppression rule: if global error rate < 1% but canary errors > 0, degrade alert priority. Avoid paging for isolated canary blips.
Marco L: Please add a dashboard panel that overlays canary failures with regional pod restarts and queue length. Ticket it if not there.
Priya K: Created ticket: INC-4821 with links to dashboard and probe config. I'll post the ticket link once done.
incident-bot: Note: Pager muted for monitor prod-east-canary by Priya K until 2026-03-15T15:30:00Z
Priya K: I applied the updated config, monitors reloaded. Watching for new failures.
Priya K: Observed 2 failures in 10m then healthy. No paging. Channel alert posted for the 3/5 non-paging threshold.
Janelle F: Good. Next steps: (1) formalize new default canary thresholds in runbook, (2) add a "canary health" dashboard with per-region time-series and probe metadata, (3) plan longer-term fix for backend cold-starts.
Marco L: Handoff: I'm taking oncall for the next 30m to watch for regressions. Priya, leave the pager muted and add notes to handoff channel.
Priya K: Handoff posted to #eng-oncall-handoffs. Key notes: probe tuned to 60s/5fail/10m, paging disabled for that monitor, created INC-4821, watch for sustained 5min failures.
Ravi S: I'll follow up with infra to check VM warm pools in prod-east.
Priya K: Thanks team. Closing the immediate thread; reopen if it pages again.
ops-bot: Action recorded: monitor config change documented in runbook v2.1 by Priya K
